author: izjust4fun
body:
Hey guys, here's mine and Red's newest map Bermuda! 


Features:

~ Pirates (Black) vs Islanders (Orange)

~ Double obsidian monuments.

~ Enchanting table.

~ Boats.

~ Boat launch and a giant waterside.

~ and more! :D


Pictures~ http://imgur.com/a/bIwIw


YML~ http://pastebin.com/NQ7STfrv


Download~ http://www.mediafire.com/download/3ovjov4vxvu3nff/Bermuda.zip (Map is found at x~ -1213 , y~ 63, z~ -938) Also might show up as Tropico. Best to take a look at it in game. Also the map is subject to change!


All feedback is appreciated! Thank you :)

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Awesome map!

Few problems: Since the map was built on a different version than the server, all of the chests are empty and the signs are incorrect. Also, The item frames are dropped on map load. Boat launchers do work still. Only yml change needed was change "cooked salmon" to "cooked fish:1"

One of the best maps I have seen, no idea how it will play, but it is one of the few maps i really want to try out. Please update it in 1.7 , refill the chests / item frames and update the signs. As soon as you get it done let me know and ill test it out.

Thanks again
